question: Does schema version 10 preserve released writable databases and portable read-only archives well enough to ship the unified parent, evidence, child-family, and repository/head-SHA workflow ordering contract?
rationale: The implementation and proof establish the race fix, but accepting new durable canonical-selection, backfill, and rejection semantics across existing archives requires store release-owner intent.

options.title: Complete store-owner review
options.body: Accept after confirming fresh installation, v0.7.1/schema-6 upgrade, an intermediate schema upgrade, overlapping synchronization, and legacy read-only behavior on representative archives.

options.title: Keep the branch draft
options.body: Pause landing until the release owner is prepared to own the expanded persistent freshness contract.
